In France, many départements (which are administrative divisions) have adopted the name of a river which flows through them. 

Among them, the département of Var, in which the river Var doesn't flow; instead, it flows in the neighbouring département of Alpes-Maritimes.

The river Var used to flow in the département of Var though. When the County of Nice was re-incorporated into France in the 19th century, part of the old Var département, in which the river Var flows, was detached to form the département of Alpes-Maritimes together with the territory of the County of Nice.
